payload.title: File:Dystrophaeus viaemalae holotype ulna.png
payload.credit_html: Rearranged figures from plate LXXXIII of "Report upon United States Geographical Surveys west of the one hundredth meridian", from scan at https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/bibliography/49058
payload.description_html: Illustration of the right ulna of USNM 2364, the holotype of the sauropod dinosaur Dystrophaeus viaemalae, in five views. Identified as a left humerus in original caption, but recognized as a right ulna by Huene (1904) "Dystrophaeus viaemalae Cope in neuer Beleuchtung".
